data: What does the shift action do in the model?

The shift action in the model moves an element from the buffer to the stack. In the given example, the model predicts that the element '3' will be shifted from the buffer to the stack. This can be observed in the transition from Figure (1) to Figure (2), where the element '3' is moved from the buffer to the stack.
